svg.title: low-bits
svg.desc: Left: bits per cached number in BF16, FP8 and FP4, plus the small share taken by the group scales. Right: a toy key cache of 8 tokens by 8 channels with two outlier channels, quantized to 2 bits. Grouping per token lets each outlier stretch the scale, so the ordinary numbers collapse to two levels; grouping per channel keeps them close to the original.
